sourceReceipt.copyScope: The six original P8 checks are copied without alteration. The source receipt includes other modules and versions and may later receive more checks.

exact.displayDerivation: Sort the recorded slopes and take cumulative sums; Float64 display only.
exact.polynomialConvention: v_p(p)=1; root valuations are negatives of lower Newton-polygon slopes.

exact.weightDerivation: For the recorded projective Tate class F=p^i, its Weil weight is 2i. This relies on the stated projective comparison; it is not a general eigenvalue weight classifier.

exact.prefixReduction: Forget the last compatible-sequence component; this is not a claimed reverse ring homomorphism between finite field extensions.

sourceTheorem.scope: the selected completed standard field and its completed torus, all root levels together
